_readme: Crop growing season types. Read by kubejs/server_scripts/tags/cropseasontags.js, which fills the block tags
creativeengineering:crop_seasons/<type> (blocks) and the item tags of the same name (items); patcherMod
seasons/CropSeasons reads them for growth, the planting-item tooltip and WTHIT. Edit, then /reload.
Reference and owner spec: feature_writeup/crops.md 2.12.1; check with python3 tools/crop_season_audit.py.
Each season is fertile (growth +25 %), neutral (normal) or off (growth -25 %), from the biome's own calendar:
spring/summer/autumn/winter in temperate and cold biomes, wet/dry in tropical, dry and arid ones.
temperate     spring fertile, summer and autumn neutral, winter off; wet neutral, dry off.
cold          winter fertile, spring and autumn neutral, summer off; wet and dry off.
warm_dry      summer fertile, spring and autumn neutral, winter off; dry fertile, wet neutral.
warm_wet      summer fertile, spring and autumn neutral, winter off; wet fertile, dry neutral.
autumn_fruit  autumn fertile, spring and summer neutral, winter off; wet neutral, dry off (Vinery apple trees).
nether        fertile in the Nether, off everywhere else.
end           fertile in the End, off everywhere else.
cave          by height, not season: fertile below y 0, off above y 128 (CEConfig [crop_seasons]).
mushroom      fertile in mushroom biomes (#forge:is_mushroom), temperate elsewhere.
grape_temperate, grape_cold, grape_warm_dry, grape_warm_wet  by biome family, not season: fertile in their own
family, offseason in the opposite temperature (cold against warm dry or warm wet), else neutral.
Temperate grapes have no opposite. Families: cold, frozen and permanent winter biomes cold; dry and
arid warm dry; tropical warm wet; the rest temperate.
grape         the grape type of the grape the block holds (Vinery grapevine stem and lattice).
none          seasons never apply (documents the choice; same as unlisted).
blocks: the block whose growth fires the crop-grow event (what growth reads; the planting item of a block
shows its tooltip automatically). items: extra planting items for the tooltip (saplings of fruit leaves, tree fruits, seeds
that are not block items). A block or item in two types is an error. Ids that are not registered are skipped.
Added to #sereneseasons:greenhouse_glass (Serene Seasons fills it with #forge:glass). A seasonal crop with any of
these in the 16 blocks straight above it has no seasons: fertile and offseason both become neutral. Only the
crop's own column counts: one glass block or pane anywhere in it is enough, blocks between do not matter, light
is not checked. Nether, End and cave crops ignore it. Entries: block ids, '#tags' or '/regex/' (KubeJS).
Counted: full glass blocks of every kind, glass panes, glass doors and trapdoors. Not counted: pipes, casings,
hourglasses, cabinets with glass doors.
